@@U03223@@
we regulate the cycles of sun and moon, witness the supreme fate of nations, see war and peace, drought and flood— with calm passivity.

@@U03225@@
RIVER GOD 珀涅俄斯河 surrounded by TRIBUTARY RIVER GODS and NYMPHS.

@@U03227@@
(Waking.)

@@U03228@@
Rustling rushes, stir, stir slowly! Tangled sister reeds breathe lowly! Willows waving, softly sighing, To the aspens’ thrill replying, Soothe my interrupted dream! A dreadful premonition wakes me, Some mysterious tremor shakes me From my slumber-peaceful stream.

@@U03230@@
(Approaching the river's edge.)

@@U03231@@
Do my ears deceive me? Are there voices behind these twining leaves and branches? How human they sound. The rippling waters chatter on, and breezes titter away in jest.

@@U03233@@
(To 浮士德)

@@U03234@@
Come to our streams, Here you'll find rest, Here let your dreams Answer your quest. Here in the cool Your limbs will be dressed, By our soft rustling pool We'll sing you to rest.
translation:
@@U03223@@
我们调节太阳和月亮的周期，见证国家的最高命运，看到战争与和平、干旱与洪水——以平静的被动。

@@U03225@@
河神珀涅俄斯河被支流河神和仙女包围。

@@U03227@@
（醒来。）

@@U03228@@
灯芯草沙沙作响，搅拌，慢慢搅拌！纠结的芦苇姐姐低声呼吸！柳树摇曳，轻声叹息， 白杨激动地回应， 抚慰我中断的梦！一种可怕的预感唤醒了我，某种神秘的颤抖将我从沉睡的宁静溪流中摇醒。

@@U03230@@
（快到河边了。）

@@U03231@@
难道是我的耳朵欺骗了我？这些缠绕的树叶和树枝背后是否有声音？他们听起来多么人性化。碧波荡漾，微风嬉笑。

@@U03233@@
（致浮士德）

@@U03234@@
来到我们的溪流，在这里你会找到休息，在这里让你的梦想回答你的追求。在凉爽的这里，你的四肢将被穿上，在我们柔软的沙沙池边，我们将唱歌让你休息。
